missing_pieces.duty: ED26-P15-CH-exchangeability-and-definetti-C002 (partial): Worked boundary not supplied. Statement (body 45-55) and proof (annex 4-37) give only the positive facts: finite-vector symmetry iff T_pi-invariance, the sigma-field and decrease properties, the tail field inside E, and the pullback reduction. No limiting or failure case is worked in the entry, its proof, or any entry tied to it. The natural boundary, that the tail inclusion can be strict, is worked on route at handbook/annex/p15/limsup-events-and-zero-one-laws.tex 350-358, but this entry neither reproduces nor cites it.

ED26-P15-CH-exchangeability-and-definetti-C003 (partial): Worked boundary not supplied. The only boundary content is two unworked remarks: different integrands may have different exceptional null sets (body 67), and no boundedness is needed beyond integrability (annex 60-61). No case at the edge of the integrability hypothesis or of the null-set limitation is worked in the entry, its proof, or an entry that cites this theorem as its boundary. The infinite-mean case at handbook/parts/p15/exchangeability-and-predictive-induction-w02b-p15-022.tex 904-906 is tied to the reverse strong law, not to this theorem.

ED26-P15-CH-feller-bernstein-hausdorff-C002 (partial): Construction or argument incomplete for a promised case (unstated assumption). The Poisson and gamma conclusions are asserted for positive real n tending to infinity (body 40-41, 53-56; annex 38-39, 50). The proof gets them, including the uniform-on-compacts versions, from 'the preceding lemma' / 'the same lemma' (annex 42-43, 52-53). But thm:p15-feller-concentration is stated only for families indexed by positive integers n (body 17). No step extends the lemma to real-indexed families, so the real-n case rests on the lemma outside its stated hypothesis.

ED26-P15-CH-feller-bernstein-hausdorff-C006 (partial): Worked boundary not supplied. Statement (body 119-135) and proof (annex 95-120) give the dual representation, the explicit error bound, the Lipschitz rate and the affine transfer to [a,b] with a<b. No boundary case of the theorem is worked, for example a discontinuous u or the excluded degenerate interval a=b. thm:p15-feller-approximation-boundaries (body 400-420) works boundaries only for the concentration lemma and for absolute monotonicity, not for this theorem.

ED26-P15-CH-feller-bernstein-hausdorff-C016 (partial): Worked boundary not supplied. The entry's only edge content is the notational convention that the empty product is one (body 354). No case at the edge of its hypotheses is worked in the entry (body 344-358), its proof (annex 555-584), or any entry tied to it. Those hypotheses are positive weights b and r and reinforcement c>0, on which the beta(b/c, r/c) identification depends.
